description: Nuestro equipo quiere experimentar lo que significa participar en este evento mundial y poner a disposición nuestros conocimientos y experiencias para resolver este desafío
summary:
Our team consists of two adults and two children, aged 8 and 10. We decided to develop this project because we believe it is essential to raise awareness about the growing problem of pollution in space. Although humanity does not yet inhabit space, there is already a significant amount of debris and pollution that could impact future exploration and settlements.

To address this issue in an accessible and easy-to-understand way, we have created a story aimed at children. Through this narrative, we seek to foster—from an early age—an understanding of how important it is to care not only for our own planet but also for the places we might one day inhabit. We are convinced that education and environmental awareness are the keys to building a more responsible and sustainable future, both on Earth and beyond.
details:
Our project is a children’s book that allows kids to learn more about the waste that humans have left on the Moon and Mars.

This book is created by children for children, as the team members are 8 and 10 years old.
